subject: Modular observability bundle — pricing & discount framework
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@brightline.com>
Cc: Tim Jones <tim.jones@brightline.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Modular observability bundle — quick pricing framework

Hi Sara / Tim,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really enjoyed the walkthrough of how Brightline routes clinical logs through your pipeline. You mentioned wanting clearer economics for observability (retention, tracing, advanced dashboards) so the app team can evaluate trade-offs.

I put together a short modular approach:
- Core retention (30d default)
- Tracing/latent sampling as an add-on (event-level)
- Advanced dashboards (per-seat + ingestion slab)

Could you confirm a rough monthly ingest profile for the last 3 months (events/day, 99th percentile trace size, and active dashboard seats)? If you can attach an anonymized sample (CSV or XLS) that’ll let me map to a savings tier.

Goal: I’ll sketch 2 pricing scenarios — conservative (no commit) and committed (12–24 mo) with volume discounts and a credits structure for overages. If a procurement review is needed, we’ll include a sample SOW and negotiation-friendly line items (SLA/retention carve-outs).

If useful, I can share a short spreadsheet showing cost delta between 30d vs 90d retention + sampling.

Next steps: send ingest sample -> I’ll return a two-option commercial (within 48 hrs).

Best,
Connor O’Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment: obs_pack_pricing_v2.pdf (pricing matrix, 3 pages)

Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Modular observability bundle — quick pricing framework

Connor — thanks, this is great context.

Attached is a small sample export and a high-level traffic summary for March (anonymized). High level:
- Avg events/day: ~1.1M
- Peak day (Mar 12): ~2.3M
- 99th percentile trace size: ~18KB
- Dashboard seats: ~12 active (product & ops)

We are very interested in: 1) a committed discount for 12–24 month terms, and 2) options to limit retention for lower-value namespaces to 7–14d. Procurement will want a clean SLA table and an example SOW line for dashboards.

We can share the sample as usage_sample.xlsx. Tim from ops is cc’d and can clarify event types if you need.

—Sara
Sara Liu
Head of Platform Engineering | Brightline Health
sara.liu@brightline.com
Attachment: usage_sample.xlsx (anonymized daily buckets)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 08:16:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Modular observability bundle — quick pricing framework

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Brightline’s sample (attached in thread). Key asks: committed tier (12–24mo) and retention segmentation per namespace.

My thinking for a first-pass commercial:
- Option A (Flex): no commit, higher per-ingest rate, baseline 30d retention, tracing sampled at 1% by default, dashboards billed per active seat.
- Option B (Commit 12mo): 20% off per-ingest rates, 50% dashboard discount for seats >10, 30d -> configurable retention buckets (7/30/90) with volume credits for archival moved to cold store.
- Add-ons: tracing full-event (higher egress) and priority SLO (premium).

Questions for pricing math:
1) Do we want credits vs overage billing for retention tiers? (credits smooth renewals but complicate invoicing)
2) Can we push a minimum seat commitment (e.g., commit 10 seats) in Option B?
3) How aggressive on discount for 24mo commit vs 12mo (add’l 8–12%?)

I’ve attached a quick matrix (obs_pack_pricing_v2.pdf) — it’s intentionally conservative. If we do credits, I propose a rollover cap of 3 months.

Callout: procurement will ask for SOW language — I suggest we prepare a simple paragraph tying retention SLAs to retained token counts and provide an archival process.

Connor

Sara / Tim — thanks for the sample. We reviewed it with finance and product and can send a two-option commercial for Brightline. Summary highlights below and attached: obs_pack_pricing_v2.pdf (includes line-item SOW examples and an SLA appendix).

Offer (summary):
- Option 1 — No-commit Flex: baseline ingest $0.0021 / event; 30d retention; tracing sampling at 1% (ability to purchase full traces as add-on); dashboards $75/seat/month.
- Option 2 — 12mo Commit: 20% off baseline ingest ($0.00168 / event), dashboards $45/seat/month for seats 1–10, $33/seat/month for seats 11+. Minimum seat commitment: 10 seats. Retention tiers configurable (7/30/90) with archival credits (1 credit = 100k events of cold archival). Rollover cap: 3 months.

Discount mechanics and concessions:
- 24mo commit considered: additional 8% off list for ingest rates (can be layered on top of 12mo).
- Procurement-friendly SOW language included (page 2) — explicit retention boundaries and data deletion workflow.
- We’re willing to include one quarter of free onboarding credits (worth $6k) for a signed 12mo deal.

Attachments: obs_pack_pricing_v2.pdf, usage_sample.xlsx (as provided).

Next steps: If this looks directionally correct, I’ll open a draft HubSpot deal and schedule a short pricing walk-through with your team + procurement. Can we target Thurs at 10am PT for a 30-min call?

Thanks — looking forward to progressing.
Connor O’Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
